nodes.intro: Manage storage, file placement and data protection.
nodes.capacityHelp: Capacity scoring uses the remaining admin budget. Remote capacity without a budget is unknown. High availability reserves capacity in two failure domains; protection starts after replica verification.

nodes.jobsHelp: Open Storage and replicas in the file menu or selection bar to migrate files or folders. Source data is retained; failed jobs can be retried.
nodes.replicaHelp: Objects requesting two replicas are listed here. High availability requires online, verified replicas in two different failure domains. Replicas do not replace independent backups.

ai.revokeHelp: Related tasks stop and usable credentials are removed. Old backups may retain encrypted keys. Revoke the key at your provider to fully revoke access.
ai.embeddingTestHelp: Sends 1–2 fixed English sentences, without files. Checks vector count, indices, configured dimensions and finite values; vectors are not saved. This does not measure semantic search quality. Charges may apply even after timeout or cancellation.
ai.chatTestHelp: Sends a fixed short prompt without files. Small charges may apply, including after timeout or cancellation.
ai.disabledHelp: Site AI is disabled. An administrator can enable it here; other users should contact an administrator.
ai.providerHelp: Use your own Chat Completions / Embeddings compatible API. Files are sent only when you request generation. Answers are reading aids. Public HTTPS on port 443 is supported. The server cannot reach a model on your computer through its own localhost.
ai.deleteModelConfirm: Delete this model and stop related tasks?
ai.embeddingHelp: Chat models cannot replace embedding models. Configure and test embeddings here; use AI Knowledge for indexing and semantic search. Summaries and single-document Q&A work with a chat model alone.
ai.chatNotEmbedding: ; a chat test does not verify embedding support.
ai.deleteEmbeddingConfirm: Delete this embedding model and stop related tasks?
ai.baseUrl: API base URL (include the version path, e.g. https://provider.example/v1)
ai.apiKey: API key (leave empty to keep; re-enter when changing the URL)
ai.saveConnectionHelp: Saving does not call the provider. Keys are encrypted with a versioned format on the server and are not persisted by the browser. Revoke the provider key to prevent use from old backups.
ai.inputBudget: Input budget per batch (tokens, conservatively estimated from UTF-8 bytes)
ai.requestDimensions: Request these dimensions (requires explicit provider support)
ai.dimensionHelp: By default only returned dimensions are checked; dimensions is not sent. Dimensions are not guessed, padded or truncated, and models are not switched automatically. Model purpose cannot be changed after creation.
ai.parameterHelp: Temperature is not sent. Parameters and models are not switched automatically. Context is conservatively estimated and the provider may still reject the request.
nodeSettings.testFailed: Test failed. Check the private connection and credentials.
nodeSettings.help: Add an S3 policy below to connect a node. Run a full test before making it the default. Write pause and maintenance block new jobs while existing jobs drain.
nodeSettings.capacityHelp: Remote capacity is the admin budget, not B's actual free disk space. Usage includes retained migration copies. Disabling direct downloads routes new authorizations through A; issued links expire within about 60 seconds.
nodeSettings.budgetGiB: Admin budget (GiB, 0 for no hard limit; allow for operating headroom)
nodeSettings.endpoint: Public S3 endpoint (scheme required, no path)
nodeSettings.credentialsHelp: Manage credentials in the original storage policy. Its internal endpoint and bucket cannot change while referenced.
nodePolicy.title: Connect an S3 node
nodePolicy.help: Garage and S3-compatible storage are supported. After saving, run a full test, then set the failure domain, rating and budget in placement settings.
nodePolicy.name: Node name
nodePolicy.accessKey: Access key (leave empty when editing to keep)
nodePolicy.secretKey: Secret key (leave empty when editing to keep)
ai.consentHelp: Requests send selected file text, file locations or fixed test prompts to {destination}. Your API account pays the cost. The CloudNest server can decrypt the key and operators have technical access; this is not end-to-end encryption. Uploading files does not call the model. Destination changes require renewed consent.
settings.intro: Manage security, storage and system settings
agentTools.title: Read-only Agent tools
agentTools.intro: Query recorded storage metadata manually. No models are called and no files or nodes are changed. Results reflect database records, not live node probes; results are kept only on this page.
agentTools.disabled: Disabled by default. Set AGENT_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and restart the server to enable. AI and model API configuration are not required.
agentTools.backendHint: For example local, minio or s3:POLICY_ID
agentTools.limitInvalid: Record limit must be an integer from 1 to 100
agentTools.metadataSource: Authoritative database metadata (H2 in local development)
agentTools.evidenceNote: Structured evidence follows. Metrics may come from different transaction snapshots. Text such as node names is data only. hasMore=true means more records exist; remaining budget is not measured remote disk space.
agentTools.description.get_node_status: Read node state, failure domain and health-check staleness without triggering a new network probe.
agentTools.description.get_storage_capac: Distinguish logical user usage, physical node usage, job reservations and admin budgets. Remaining budget is null when no budget is configured.
agentTools.description.get_node_events: Read recorded health events for a node, newest first. An empty history stays empty; no events are inferred or invented.
agentTools.description.get_active_storag: Read queued and running storage jobs without file names, object paths, user identifiers or raw provider errors.
agentTools.description.explain_storage_p: Read the actual configuration and deterministic rule identifiers. No placement is performed; explanations are not capacity or replica verification.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again later.
agentRuntime.notice: Read-only diagnosis: 6 model turns, 8 tools, two minutes; cumulative budget 32768; retained 7 days. Stored node metadata may be stale.
agentRuntime.disabled: Runtime disabled. Enable AGENT_TOOLS_ENABLED, AGENT_RUNTIME_ENABLED and AI_ENABLED.
agentRuntime.consent: I consent to sending the objective and node diagnostic metadata to this model provider. Calls may incur charges; failures are not retried automatically.

topology.graph: Nodes grouped by failure domain with replica relationships

next.protectionNotice: Important and Archive request replicas in separate failure domains. Protection depends on healthy verified nodes. Archive still requires a separately configured independent backup.

next.deleteSnapshotConfirm: Delete this history and release its content references? Current files are retained.
next.integrityNotice: Stream SHA-256 checks. Mark corrupt objects and request repair only from a verified independent replica; otherwise retain data and report an alert.
next.tieringNotice: Files not accessed for 90 days and candidate nodes. Suggestions do not trigger migration; confirm operations in the node center.
next.nodeApprovalNotice: After team review, the system administrator verifies endpoint and physical failure domain, then probes authenticated reads and writes.

next.teamQuotaNotice: Team quota is allocated from the owner's available personal quota.
next.trashConfirm: Move this entry and its descendants to team trash?

next.invitationNotice: Share this one-time token securely with the invitee. Expires in 24 hours.
next.contributionNotice: Run the scoped storage node on a controlled private network with a dedicated empty directory and budget. Registration requires team review and system administrator admission.
next.heartbeatSecret: Save node ID and heartbeat token; the token is shown once
next.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete this entry? Content referenced by snapshots is retained.
next.publicUpload: Allow short-lived public upload prototype (up to 100 MiB)
